typography.notes: Use uppercase Barlow Condensed for all section headers and giant numbers (like Race Mode stats). Keep it heavily tracked (tracking-wide or tracking-tight depending on size). Manrope for body text for clean readability.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl+ font-black uppercase tracking-tighter leading-none

buttons.primary: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FF3B30] to-[#FF6A00] text-white font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-8 py-4 rounded-none border border-transparent hover:border-white/20 transition-all shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,59,48,0.3)]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-white border-2 border-white/20 px-8 py-4 uppercase font-bold tracking-wider hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors

cards.style: bg-[#121212] border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-8 shadow-2xl relative overflow-hidden

sections_and_content.name: Navigation
sections_and_content.instructions: Sticky glassmorphism header (bg-black/60, backdrop-blur-xl). Left: Logo 'BikerLink'. Middle: Links (Mappa, Proposte, Match, Club, Chat). Right: IT/EN Language Toggle and 'Scarica App' CTA. Include data-testid for all links.

sections_and_content.name: Hero Cinematic
sections_and_content.instructions: Full viewport height (min-h-screen). Background image of racing motorcycle overlaid with bg-gradient-to-r from-black/90 via-black/50 to-transparent. Left-aligned text. H1: 'CONNETTI LA TUA PASSIONE'. Subtitle: 'Piattaforma social e di utilità per la community motociclistica italiana.' Dual CTAs: App Store and Google Play (using Lucide icons).

sections_and_content.name: User Types (Chi Sei?)
sections_and_content.instructions: Bento layout (12 cols). Show 3 cards. 1. Biker (col-span-1 md:col-span-4). 2. Zavorrine (col-span-1 md:col-span-4). 3. Coppie (col-span-1 md:col-span-4). Use background images for each card with a heavy bottom-to-top dark gradient (bg-gradient-to-t from-black via-black/60 to-transparent). Text placed at the bottom inside the card.

sections_and_content.name: Core Features (Control Room)
sections_and_content.instructions: Dense, technical grid. Features to highlight: Mappa Real-Time, Matching Engine (18 tipi di match), Route Planning (Curvy Roads), Hands-Off System. Use 'Tracing Beam' or glowing border effect on hover. Use Lucide icons (Map, Zap, Users, ShieldAlert).

sections_and_content.name: Safety & Privacy
sections_and_content.instructions: High contrast section with deep red accents. Highlight 'SOS Biker' (100km radius), 'Privacy' (blurred coordinates), and 'Hands-Off' (UI block over 50km/h). Minimalist layout, use large iconography.

sections_and_content.name: Race Mode
sections_and_content.instructions: Adrenaline-fueled section. Background: deep black. Show massive typography for metrics: 'Velocità', '0-100', 'Angolo di Piega'. Use the dashboard image on one side, and huge glowing red numbers on the other. It should feel like looking at a telemetry screen.

sections_and_content.name: MotoClub & Community
sections_and_content.instructions: Highlight group rides, group chats (SSE), and proposals (Proposte). Use the motorcycle group image. Warm, brotherhood vibe but maintaining the dark/racing aesthetic.

sections_and_content.name: Pic! Contest
sections_and_content.instructions: Weekly photo contest section. Show a sleek slider/carousel of biker photos. Use Shadcn Carousel if applicable, or a grid of images. Subtitle: 'Vota la foto della settimana'.

sections_and_content.name: FAQ
sections_and_content.instructions: Use Shadcn Accordion. Dark, flat surfaces with 1px border. Highlight questions about Privacy, App cost, and SOS coverage.

sections_and_content.name: Footer
sections_and_content.instructions: Massive typography 'BIKERLINK' at the bottom. Columns for Socials, App Store / Play Store links, Legal/Privacy. Very generous top padding (py-32).

icon_strategy.style: Use stroke-width 1.5. Colors: white for standard, #FF3B30 for active or safety-related icons (like ShieldAlert for SOS).

animation_motion.interactions: Hover states on cards should translate-y-[-4px] and increase border opacity. Buttons should have a subtle scale effect (scale-105) on hover.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on #0A0A0A passes APCA. For orange/red buttons, use white text and heavy font weight to ensure legibility.
accessibility.testing: MANDATORY: Add data-testid to ALL links, buttons, and interactive elements.
